senses.gloss: m. (גמם to couple, tie) a little yoke (בר נִירָא), or a board tied to the head of a calf (פִּינַקְסָה), or a pointed pole (שִׁירְתּוּעַ, v. preced. w.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:4">Sabb. V, 4</cite>; expl. Y. ib. V, 7ᶜ; Bab.
ib. 54ᵇ.—Y. l. c. מאן דמר ג׳ וכ׳ he who reads gimon supports the opinion of R. Ḥisda (פינקסה); he who reads gimol supports the opinions &c. (שירתוע or בר נירא).—Pl. גִּימוֹנוֹת, v. next w.
